title: A Labyrinth Engraved on the Ancient Ruins
description:
The image looks like a scanned or photographed page from a book or dossier, printed on slightly yellowed/gray aged paper. The artwork and text are in dark brown/black ink, with a clean, diagrammatic style.

MAIN GRAPHIC (UPPER HALF)
Three circular labyrinths/mazes dominate the top portion. Each maze is drawn as a thick-outlined circle filled with many concentric ring corridors and short radial walls, forming a classic labyrinth/maze pattern. The three circles are arranged like a triangle and touch/overlap slightly: one maze at the upper left, one maze at the right, and one maze at the lower left. The circles are also connected by short corridor bridges where they meet, suggesting a combined system rather than three totally separate puzzles.

CENTER MARKERS (NUMBERS)
Each labyrinth has a bold number in a small central circle:
- Upper-left maze: 3
- Right maze: 1
- Lower-left maze: 2

LETTER MARKERS (SMALL CIRCLED LETTERS)
Around the outer rings of the mazes are several small circles containing single uppercase letters:
- Upper-left (3) maze: letters U, L, E placed around its perimeter (U near the upper-left edge; L near the right edge; E near the left/lower-left area).
- Right (1) maze: letters O, A, N (O near the top; A on the right; N near the bottom).
- Lower-left (2) maze: letters N, R, I (N on the left; R on the right; I near the lower-left edge).

NOTE TEXT (MID-LOWER RIGHT)
To the right of the lower area of the diagram is a small printed note:
"NOTE
All letters have been transliterated into modern script."

The diagram presents as a stylized archaeological or cryptographic puzzle: three connected labyrinth seals labeled with numbers and letters, with an explanatory note about transliteration.

title: A Map of Midnight Movie Studios
description:
Top banner / title area
EXHIBIT D

Centered at the very top.
Printed in bold uppercase lettering.
Decorative horizontal lines extend out from both sides.
It gives the map the feel of a case file, clue, or formal exhibit.

Upper-left quadrant: Soundstages
SOUNDSTAGES

This heading sits above a cluster of stage buildings in the upper-left.
The buildings are simple rectangles, like studio stage boxes.

Stage A / Stage B
First large rectangle directly under "SOUNDSTAGES."
Split down the middle with a dotted vertical divider.
Left half labeled A, right half labeled B.

Stage C / Stage D
Second large rectangle directly below A/B.
Also split down the middle with a dotted divider.
Left half labeled C, right half labeled D.

Mystery Stage (?)
Below the C/D building is another stage-like square/rectangle.
It contains a large question mark (?) instead of a normal label.
This is one of the most visually striking details in the map.

Left-middle quadrant: Office / operations side
HEAD OFFICE

Large regular building below the soundstage area.
Positioned left-center of the map.
Labeled in two lines: HEAD / OFFICE.
Looks like the administrative hub of the studio lot.

SECURITY
Smaller irregular building in the lower-left area, beneath the Head Office.
Labeled SECURITY.
Likely near a controlled access point to the lot.

STUDIO TOUR CHECK-IN
Just to the right of the Security building.
Marked by a small booth-like icon (tiny rounded structure).
Label appears in stacked lines:
STUDIO
TOUR
CHECK-IN
This looks like the starting point for the mapped route.

Lower-left quadrant: Parking
PARKING LOT A

Large rectangular parking lot at the bottom-left.
Filled with many short line marks representing parking spaces.
Clearly labeled PARKING LOT A beneath it.

Upper-center quadrant: Backlot / sets
Unlabeled set/building shapes

Between the soundstages and the City Backlot (upper-center), there are a few irregular outlined shapes.
They're not labeled, but they look like structures, set pieces, or auxiliary buildings.

CITY BACKLOT
Large central feature in the upper-middle.
Irregular, rounded-corner block labeled CITY BACKLOT.
One of the main destination areas on the map.
The tour route runs along and across this area.

Center-middle quadrant: Production support
PROP SHOP

Located below the City Backlot.
Irregular block labeled PROP SHOP.
Sits roughly central on the map.
A vertical inner line suggests an entry partition or internal division.

Upper-right quadrant: Music / post (partially cropped)
(The map image is cropped on the right, so these are partially visible.)

SCORING STAGE
Large building near the top-right.
Labeled SCORING STAGE.
Part of the right side is cut off by the image edge.

POST LAB
Smaller rectangular building to the lower-right of the Scoring Stage.
Labeled POST LAB.
Also partially affected by the crop.

Mid-right quadrant: Water tower and restaurant area (partially cropped)
WATER TOWER (upper/right-mid label)

There is a "WATER TOWER" label near the right-center.
Near it is a circular feature that likely represents the tower base or tower footprint.

BAR & GRILL
Building/area labeled BAR & GRILL in the mid-right section.
Another "WATER TOWER" label appears above it, reading as:
WATER TOWER
BAR & GRILL
The right side of this zone is cut off, so the full footprint isn't visible.

Center-lower quadrant: Entertainment / landmark area
LUXURY THEATRE

Large, dominant building in the lower center.
Labeled LUXURY THEATRE.
Irregular shape with a rounded extension at the bottom.
Feels like a major guest-facing attraction on the lot.

MIDNIGHT STATUE
Small circular icon and label just left-lower of the Luxury Theatre.
Labeled MIDNIGHT STATUE.
The route passes close to it.

ENTRANCE GATE
Near the bottom center.
Marked by a gate-like icon (a horizontal bar with vertical supports).
Labeled ENTRANCE GATE.
Positioned just below the Midnight Statue area.

Lower-right quadrant: Fountain / parking / bungalows
FOUNTAIN

Circular feature to the right of the Luxury Theatre, labeled FOUNTAIN.
The tour route clearly loops around this point.

Right-side Parking Lot B
Rectangular parking area with stall markings above-right of the Fountain.
Label reads "PARKING LOT B".

BUNGALOWS
Diagonal row of small tilted rectangles near the bottom-right.
Labeled along the edge with angled text: BUNGALOWS.
Individual units are numbered:
1
2
3
4
They look like small offices/dressing-room buildings.

Compass rose (cropped)
Small compass symbol at the lower-right corner.
N, W, S are visible.
The east side is cut off by the image crop.

Tour path walkthrough (how the dotted route moves)
The map's dotted/chevron route with black dots appears to guide visitors through the lot. Reading it as a path:

Starts near Studio Tour Check-In (left-center/lower-left area)
Moves upward toward the left side of the central map
Passes near the edge between the soundstage/office side and the City Backlot
Runs diagonally across the upper-center, skirting the City Backlot
Turns and goes down the right side toward the Water Tower / Bar & Grill side
Continues downward toward the Fountain
Loops around the lower area near the Bungalows
Curves back leftward near the Luxury Theatre / Midnight Statue area
